integration.title: PDKS device integrations
integration.subtitle: Send device events securely into HR attendance records.
integration.bridgeDescription: A device or vendor platform reads events on its network and forwards the original payload to the endpoint below over HTTPS. Requests must use the terminal's X-Terminal-Key. This screen does not reveal a terminal key again.
integration.authHint: Replace provider with zkteco, hikvision, or suprema. Store the X-Terminal-Key created for each terminal as a secret in the connector.

zkteco.name: ZKTeco
zkteco.description: Attendance PUSH/ADMS ATTLOG rows. The user code, device time, and event state are read.

hikvision.name: Hikvision
hikvision.description: ISAPI access event XML. employeeNoString and time are required; attendanceStatus is optional.

suprema.name: Suprema BioStar 2
suprema.description: BioStar event/T&A JSON rows. User, timestamp, and an optional direction field are mapped.

steps.terminal: Register the device in the Terminals tab. Give it a unique terminal code and copy the generated API key to a secure place; it is shown only once.
steps.mapping: In Employee credentials, map each device user to an employee with the External ID credential type.
steps.gateway: Configure the local connector with the provider name and terminal API key; send data over HTTPS.
steps.timezone: Timestamps without a time-zone offset use the company's configured time zone. If direction is absent, the terminal direction mode is used.

integration.mappingExample: Example: for terminal code ZK-LOBBY-01 and device PIN 0042, assign zkteco:ZK-LOBBY-01:0042 to the employee.
